name: TeslaMate
description: Self-hosted data logger for Tesla vehicles that records drives, charges and battery health to a local database.

envVars.description: Key used to encrypt stored Tesla tokens
Hostname of an existing MQTT broker for live data

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_USER: teslamate
      DATABASE_PASS: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      DATABASE_NAME: teslamate
      DATABASE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      ENCRYPTION_KEY: {{env.ENCRYPTION_KEY}}
      TM_MQTT_HOST: {{env.TM_MQTT_HOST}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/import:/opt/app/import
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: teslamate
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: teslamate
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
